title: Miss Billy's Decision
author: Eleanor H. (Eleanor Hodgman) Porter
longDescription: Porter is a novel likely written in the early 20th century. It explores the life of Billy Neilson, who is engaged to the artist Bertram Henshaw, and the various relationships and interactions she navigates amid the playful banter and complexities of love and friendship.

authorInfo.bio: Eleanor H. (Eleanor Hodgman) Porter (1868–1920) is the author of Miss Billy's Decision. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
